locale.name: exception.console.execute.user
locale.en:
The QUIQQER console is executed with the [user] user. This user is not the owner ([owner]) of the QUIQQER system. If you continue to run the console with this user, you may experience serious permissions problems on the file system at the QUIQQER system.
Confirm with 'yes' to continue running the QUIQQER console or abort with any other input. You can also ignore the console user permissions check with '--ignore-file-permissions'.

locale.name: console.systemtool.password-reset
locale.en: Initiates a password reset for a username or UUID. Usage: ./console password-reset [username-or-UUID] [--no-interaction] [--password-stdin] If the username or UUID is provided, the identifier prompt is skipped. Confirmation prompts remain required unless --no-interaction is used. --no-interaction skips both confirmation prompts and requires a username or UUID argument. --password-stdin reads the new password from one line on STDIN instead of generating one and does not print the supplied password. Exit codes: 0 = password changed; 1 = unexpected/runtime failure; 2 = invalid identifier or user not found; 3 = cancelled or required input missing.
